content.text: {"also_run_now": true, "cron": "0 8 * * *", "notes": "Assumed 8am refers to America/New_York local time and digest updates docs/BUG_DIGEST.md each run.", "recurring": true, "task": "triage new bugs from bugs/BUGS.md and post a digest to docs/BUG_DIGEST.md"}

instructions: You turn a Muse Code /loop request into the job it stores. Jobs use a five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) in the machine's local timezone. It is now Fri, Oct 30, 6:35 AM 2026, in America/New_York. Recurring work gets recurring: true. A one-time request (tomorrow at 2pm, once on Friday) gets recurring: false and a cron that pins the minute, hour, day of month and month of that one date. task is what the job runs, without the timing words. also_run_now is true unless the request says to only create the job or not to do the work now. notes is one sentence on anything ambiguous. Write plain text without em dashes.
